note: STRUCTURAL — deletion, which apply-queue.mjs has no op for and should not have. Run: node scripts/figma/drop-settings-duplicates.mjs docs/design-jobs/V2-TO-V1/plans/settings-duplicates.json [--apply]. Every row is matched by EXACT string inside a named scope; more than one match is REFUSED, not applied.

structural.idProvenance: board id from the committed section dump scratchpad_audit/mod/sections/21-settings-s7-46.txt; the node itself is unresolved-id and is found by its exact string at apply time
structural.why: UX-I-32 (Major, duplicate-feature) — HeadersScreen.tsx:268-280 renders its own primary AND registers with the central savebar (:119), so two identical-in-effect, differently-labelled Saves are live at once. One Save, in one place: the savebar. NOTE the script reports NOT-DRAWN rather than failing where the board never drew this button — FIG-M-21 says 2209:11816 draws a header 'Save changes' instead, and that node is deleted by the header pass.

structural.idProvenance: board id from the committed section dump; node unresolved-id, found by exact string inside the savebar frame at apply time
structural.why: UX-I-36 (Major, missing-feedback) — Domains writes IMMEDIATELY on its own buttons and never makes the savebar dirty, so the bar reads '0 unsaved' over a screen that has already committed to the server. V2's fix is that a section which writes immediately says so and does not render the bar; the saying-so half is the info band in settings-notices.json, this is the not-rendering half.
